purpose: Make DWG CIRCLE and ARC parsing reject nonpositive radii consistently with native object validity and the DXF reader.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
authority.wireMapping: ARC/CIRCLE radius is a BD field, group 40.

nativeContract.requirement: Radius must be greater than zero.

implementation.behavior: DWG CIRCLE and ARC parsers now refuse a finite radius less than or equal to zero before committing parsed geometry. Their existing failure paths invalidate the cursor and reset the destination entity state.
implementation.scope: Malformed record handling only; record-level error softening remains with the caller.

generatedControls.method: Encode local CIRCLE and ARC frames, replace the positive BD radius bit span with a same-width negative BD value, then invoke the typed parser directly.
assertions: negative-radius CIRCLE and ARC parsing refuses
failed parsing resets radius, center and ARC parameters
the same typed parser instance accepts the original valid frame on retry
generatedControls.fixturePolicy: Generated frames are kept in memory; no DWG/DXF fixture was added.

validation.build: cmake -S . -B build-gcc -DCMAKE_POLICY_VERSION_MINIMUM=3.5 -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release PASS; cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_dwg_circle_arc_positive_radius_reader_tests -j6 PASS

limitations: The direct generated AC1021 parser control proves one same-width negative-radius profile; it does not establish malformed-source prevalence or native recovery behavior.
The broader P6 geometry/no-loss and whole-drawing gates remain open.
supportClaimEffect: Closes a bounded DWG CIRCLE/ARC nonpositive-radius parser inconsistency; no broad support claim is promoted.
